text:
Customer: DataTrust Support: Hey team — our compliance team just noticed that audit logs older than 90 days are missing from the console for org org-8812. Contractually we should have 365 days retention. Can you confirm?
Marta Gonzalez: hi! logged receipt, sorry about the disruption. Quick q: is the customer using SSO? and do they have a service account that needs access?
Customer: DataTrust Support: Yes SSO (Okta). Multiple users can't access older logs, including a service account we use for exports. The billing portal shows 365 days retention though.
Asha Patel: thanks. can you paste the exact error you see when trying to download older logs or run the export API? a screenshot or the error body helps.
Customer: DataTrust Support: When we call the export endpoint we get 403 + body: {
  "error": "entitlement_missing",
  "message": "org does not have audit_logs_read entitlement for requested retention window"
}
Marta Gonzalez: ok that's helpful. two likely causes: 1) entitlement sync didn't apply the retention override for this org, or 2) the calling principal (SSO user or api key) doesn't have the audit:read scope mapped via SSO role claims. We'll repro.
Ben Cho: starting repro with the customer's org and a non-admin SSO user. reproduction steps I used: 
```
# attempt export via API
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/orgs/org-8812/audit/export?start=2024-01-01&end=2024-02-01"
```
Response: 403 + {"error":"entitlement_missing","code":"audit_retention_short","details":"requested range exceeds org retention (90d)"}
Ben Cho: Also tried with the org admin API key and got 200 for the same range. So this indicates a per-principal entitlement difference.
Asha Patel: thanks. @Marta can you check the entitlement record in the entitlements service for org-8812? specifically the value for `audit_logs_retention_days` and a list of principals with explicit audit_read grants.
Marta Gonzalez: looked at entitlements service (quick db read). current row: org=org-8812, retention_days=90, retention_override_requested=true. billing_portal shows 365 because billing_mirror table is 365. sync job `entitlements.sync` hasn't picked up the billing change — CRON next run is in 6h.
SRE Bot: scheduled job entitlements.sync ran 2026-03-13T02:20Z; next run in 5h 12m
Marta Gonzalez: also noticed: the SSO claim mapping for Okta group `compliance-reviewers` isn't configured. That group should map to role `audit_reader` which grants `audit:read`. So the service account and SSO users are falling back to default role (viewer) with no audit_read.
Customer: DataTrust Support: how did that mapping get removed? Nothing changed on our Okta side.
Asha Patel: possible cause: we recently rolled out the new SSO mapping UI and a migration script had a bug that silently dropped unmapped group entries for some orgs. Eng-Auth is already tracking.
Ben Cho: proposed quick mitigation for the customer: 1) create a temporary API key from an org admin and use it for export jobs (has audit read). 2) Or add the missing Okta group mapping in the Admin Console under Settings -> SSO -> Group role mapping (add `compliance-reviewers -> audit_reader`). 3) We'll also trigger an immediate entitlements.sync for this org to pick up retention 365. Which one do you prefer?
Customer: DataTrust Support: admin ki is sensitive — we'd rather the group mapping fix and the retention fixed server-side. Can you do an immediate sync?
Marta Gonzalez: done. I triggered entitlements.sync for org-8812 manually (job id sync-4789). Checked entitlements service again: retention_days now 365, and there's an explicit principal grant for role audit_reader on group okta:compliance-reviewers.
Marta Gonzalez: after that, I tested the same curl with a representative SSO user in that Okta group — export returned 200 and a gzipped CSV.
Ben Cho: added a defensive check to return clearer error codes in cases where billing and entitlements diverge (PR #4894).
Asha Patel: next steps / action items: 
- Eng-Auth: investigate migration script that removed group mappings (assigned to @Ben).
- Eng-Entitlements: add alert if billing retention != entitlements retention for any org (assigned to @Marta).
- Support Ops: notify the customer and ask them to confirm they can access older logs from their regular users (assigned to @Asha).
- Security: review service account audit policies — ensure SA keys have explicit limited scopes (note: temporary admin key use discouraged).
Marta Gonzalez: raising internal incident INC-2345 to track root cause and remediation timeline. ETA for a permanent fix (migration script rollback + retention drift alert) is 2 business days.
Customer: DataTrust Support: thanks, we can confirm exports work now for users in the compliance group. Can you also confirm historical logs from >365 days are not recoverable?
Marta Gonzalez: confirming: we only retained 90 days until the billing change; logs older than 90 days were expired and cannot be recovered. the billing portal showed 365 but that was the billing mirror only — entitlements controls enforcement. Apologies for the confusion.
Customer: DataTrust Support: disappointing but at least we have 365 going forward. Please send a summary and the timeline for the fix.
Asha Patel: will do — sending summary to the customer and internal channels now. Summary includes repro steps, the manual sync id (sync-4789), temporary mitigation (group mapping fix), and next steps.
SRE Bot: note: incident INC-2345 created by Marta Gonzalez at 2026-03-13T14:07Z
Marta Gonzalez: posting the final runbook we used for support engineers (copy/paste): 
```
1) Confirm error body for 403 when calling /orgs/<org>/audit/export — look for "entitlement_missing" or "audit_retention_short".
2) Check entitlements service: SELECT retention_days, retention_override_requested FROM entitlements WHERE org_id='org-XXXX';
3) Check SSO group->role mappings in Admin Console or via API: GET /v1/orgs/<org>/sso/mappings
4) If mapping missing, add mapping: POST /v1/orgs/<org>/sso/mappings {"group":"compliance-reviewers","role":"audit_reader"}
5) Trigger on-demand sync: POST /internal/entitlements/sync {"org_id":"org-XXXX"}
6) Re-run export test with a user in the group. If needed, use a short-lived admin API key for emergency export and rotate immediately.
```
Marta Gonzalez: closing thread — labels: escalation, entitlements, audit-logs. ping me if anything else crops up.
Customer: DataTrust Support: thanks again everyone :pray:
